summary.text: Bill Gustoff is a Republican state representative who has represented Iowa House District 40 since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists Gustoff's career experience as an attorney.

paragraphs.text: Bill Gustoff earned a J.D. from the University of Iowa in 1995, according to Ballotpedia.
Gustoff's career experience includes working as an attorney, a managing partner of Hagenow & Gustoff LLP, and the president of the legal division of Thompson & Associates.
In the 2025-2026 session Gustoff chaired the House Ethics Committee and was assigned to the House Appropriations, House Judiciary and Public Safety committees.
